careGuide.light: Partial shade to bright indirect light
careGuide.water: Water when top inch of soil is dry

reviews.comment: Great quality plant, well packaged, and the care instructions included were super helpful.
Good quality but took a little while to adjust after arrival. Doing fine now.
Arrived in perfect condition and looks even better than the photos. Very happy with this purchase!

products.name: Parlor Palm
products.description: This Parlor Palm is a favorite among plant lovers for its striking appearance and air-purifying qualities. Perfect for a living room, it adds a calming green presence to your space.

careGuide.light: Bright, filtered light, avoid direct sun

reviews.comment: Beautiful plant, great size for the price. My space feels so much more alive now.
This plant transformed my room. Healthy, vibrant, and exactly as described.
Decent plant for the price, a couple of leaves had minor spots but otherwise healthy.
Beautiful plant, great size for the price. My space feels so much more alive now.
